election.intro: Election Day lettering, I Voted stickers, voter information scenes and portable polling place equipment. Explore clear object still lifes, varied adult community scenes and classroom practice activities, alongside detailed black and white illustrations.

The collection brings together {{artworkCount}} illustrations, including “Election Day Paper Lettering” and “A Classroom Mock Election”. Use the drawings in a civics discussion, a personal commentary project or an illustrated comparison, keeping imagined scenes distinct from real events.
